ValidationRule.description:
Created for BOPI-180. Prevents Quote being manually Client Approved without submitting the quote for approval. BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
BOPI-581 ByPass added to skip validations when syncing quote with account changes
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, "FW Approved"), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, "Client_Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(ApprovalStatus__c, "Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Quote_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please click the Submit for Approval button to update the Status
